Method of Attack: Privilege escalation bug allowing attackers to update arbitrary options
Unauthenticated SQL injection to change site and home URLs
Automatic privilege elevation via yp_remote_get_first() function checking yp_remote_get parameter on every page load
Impacted Systems: WordPress websites using Yellow Pencil Visual Theme Customizer plugin
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerability in yellow-pencil.php file via yp_remote_get request parameter
Indicators of Compromise: Changes to siteurl and home options in wordpress_options table
